title: The section-unit model computes the actual localized derived restriction.
statement: For Λ,A,a and a cartesian affine closed-fibre square (f,h,fZ), any affine closed-site test V and K-injective complexes I,J with quasi-isomorphism j:h*I→J, put T=sourceTest(V), T0=targetTest(V). The model arrow followed by the target localizationUnit and the image of Q(j) inverse and the exact h-pullback factor equals the source localizationUnit followed by localizedRestriction at QI. All these specified maps are those of [def-sfb-closed-test-localized-model-data]. This is LocalizedModelEquation and asserts no invertibility of the closed restriction.

source.place: Tags 0D6E, 0D6F, 0D6G; sites-modules.tex 04IF; derived.tex 070Y; proetale.tex 09BL. Strict part of the original coherence proof.

proof.text:
Identify localization at the source and target test objects with the corresponding
slice topoi. The ordinary slice pullback comparison is compatible with the adjunction
counit. Transpose its counit equation and apply the triangle identities to obtain the
unit equation. On each degree of I this equates the evaluated unitAt map with the
restriction unit for the actual closedFibreMap. Apply the universal derived units and
exact pullback factorization. Naturality for j moves Q(j) past the target localization
unit. Its inverse cancels Q(j), leaving precisely the displayed normalized equation.
This uses K-injectivity only for the given representatives, never for h-star I.
 The input declarations are [lem-sbc-ringed-topos-sheaf-slice-derived-comparison], [def-sfb-right-derived-functor], [lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization].
